4.name: Wiki Index
4.instructions: Call project_scanner.build_file_wiki() to refresh the codebase wiki index before task execution. The result is cached to .aixyad/wiki_index.json and injected into all subsequent agent requests as wiki_summary.

6.name: Fix build errors (Build Fixer Agent)
6.prompt: Fix all compilation errors. Read error messages, fix source files, rebuild until 0 errors.

8.name: Fix test failures (Test Fixer Agent)
8.prompt: Fix all failing tests. Read test output, fix root cause, rerun until all pass.

10.name: Subtask Review
10.instructions: After task execution, check for any incomplete subtasks. If subtasks remain undone, re-queue the parent task with status 'backlog' so it is retried in the next sprint iteration.

13.name: Fix regressions (Regression Fixer)
13.prompt: Fix any regressions introduced by the task agent.

empty_backlog.prompt: The TODO.md backlog is EMPTY. Scan the codebase for TODO/FIXME/STUB/placeholder comments, assess priority, and write 15-30 new tasks to TODO.md using ---TASK_START--- / ---TASK_END--- format.
